related_pages.title: Freeze Immunity
related_pages.wikitext_excerpt:
{{AttributeInfobox |image1 = Freeze.png |type = Immunity |variants = Regular
{{Boss}}[[Boss]] |immunities = Regular: *{{Freeze|Freeze}}Freeze *{{Freeze|Chillness}}Chillness *{{Freeze|Freeze Defense Dropping}}Freeze Defense Dropping *[[File:SledgerLevel2.png|20px|Sledger Ice Breaker]][[Sledger]] Ice Breaker {{Boss}}[[Boss]]: *{{Freeze|Freeze}}Freeze *{{Freeze|Partial Chillness}}Partial Chillness Towers & Units: *{{Freeze|Enemy Freeze}}Enemy Freeze |sandbox = No |tag = {{AttrTag|Second|Freeze.png|No Freeze}} }} ==Description== '''Freeze Immunity''' (with its tag referring to it as "''No Freeze''") is an immunity that prevents the enemy from being frozen and chilled. For towers and units, it prevents them from being frozen. ==Mechanics== '''Freeze Immunity''' makes it so that the enemy cannot be frozen. Additionally, it stops the enemy from being chilled by them. Because of its chillness immunity, it also prevents the enemies from having their defense dropped by freezing towers. Additionally, as the [[Sledger]] deals double damage to frozen or chilled enemies, it cannot deal double damage to them. Larger enemies are also frozen for a shorter amount of time than average sized enemies. The following towers/consumables become unable to apply these freeze based effects to '''Freeze Immune''' enemies: *[[Freezer]] *[[Frost Blaster]] *[[Sledger]] *[[Jester]] *[[Cryomancer]] *[[Snowballer]] *[[Elementalist]] *[[Blizzard Bomb]] *[[Pumpkin Bomb]] *[[Santa's Air Strike]] *[[Ducky Squad]] ([[Ice Ducky]]) '''Freeze Immunity''' is given to all [[Boss]] enemies, though that immunity is different from the regular one. Both version are immune to being frozen, however, it is only partially immune to chillness. It is slowed down less by chillness, but it is not immune to it. This means that bosses can have their defense dropped and can be dealt double damage to by the [[Sledger]], as long as the enemy does not have the regular '''Freeze Immunity'''. '''Freeze Immunity''' also used to prevent enemies from being slowed down from frost mark while it was still in the game. While the [[Freezer]] dealt splash damage, it could not freeze any enemy with [[Splash Damage Immunity]]. However, these enemies could still be frozen by the [[Frost Blaster]] or through its ''Ice Age'' ability. Before the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], there was an additional type of '''Freeze Immunity''', referred to as '''Basic Freeze'''. These enemies could not be frozen by the [[Freezer]]'s main attack, but could be frozen through its ''Ice Drop'' ability. ===Towers=== Certain towers and units also have the '''Freeze Immunity''', which prevents them from being frozen, though it does not prevent them from being targeted. An [[Unstable Ice]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] will still target a freeze immune [[Molten Monster]], even though it not only deals no damage but also does not freeze it. ==Enemy List== The following enemies have '''Freeze Immunity''': *[[Hazmat]] *[[Fallen Hazmat]] *[[Elite Hazmat]] *[[Elite Molten]] *[[Tanker]] *[[Molten Summoner]] *[[Giant Boss]] *[[Summoner Boss]] *[[Speedy King (Legacy)|Speedy King]] (Legacy version) *[[Hazardous]] *[[Amalgamation]] (Modern version) *[[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]] (Modern [[Polluted Wasteland II]] version) *[[Abomination]] (Legacy version) *[[Super Toxic]] (Modern version) *[[Necromancer King]] *[[Nuclear Guardian]] *[[Conjurer]] *[[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]] *[[Commander (Pizza Party)|Commander]] *[[Cavalry]] (Modern version) *[[Patient Zero]] *[[Awakened Fallen King]] *[[Molten Hazmat]] *[[Blizzard Wizard]] *[[Frost Ravager]] (With shield) *[[Deep Freeze]] *[[Frost Necromancer]] *[[Frost Champion]] *[[Void Reaper]] *[[Mandragora]] *[[Slow King]] (Modern version, with Forcefield) *[[Crystalian]] *[[Void Trickster]] *[[Void Portal]] *[[Void Cultist]] *[[Healing Beacon]] *[[Void Eye]] *[[Void Knight]] *[[Void Guardian]] *[[Golden Mystery]] All [[Boss]] enemies have their own varian

Build up chill to slow and freeze enemies in their tracks!|Store Description}} |-|Version 3 = {{QuoteBox|Chill enemies to a slow freeze!|Store Description}} |-|Version 2 = {{QuoteBox|Shoot an ice beam, freezing targets for a few seconds.|Store Description}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Freeze zombies temporarily with a freeze ray!|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Freezer''' is a ground [[Towers|tower]] that fires an ice beam and applies chill and slow down enemies, freezing at later levels. It can be bought in the store for {{Coins|650}}. The '''Freezer''' targets a single enemy and fires a ''Frost Ray'', chilling the enemy and slowing it down. The chillness slowness effect stacks with each hit multiple times. This chillness effect also deals damage over time, chipping away the health of enemies affected by it. Starting from Level 2, it can freeze enemies. When the chillness slowness effect is higher than the max slowdown, the enemy will be frozen, which generally when targeting a single enemy takes four or five shots. Larger enemies will be frozen for a shorter amount of time than average sized enemies. Enemies with [[Freeze Immunity]] also cannot be frozen, slowed down or have their defense dropped by the '''Freezer'''. At Level 3+, the '''Freezer''' fires in bursts, with a short delay between them. Additionally, at Level 3+, it drops defense by 10% every tick. It can only decrease an enemy's defense by 33%. For example, if an enemy has 50% defense, it will be decreased by 16%. On top of this, it will also start dealing damage over time with its chill at Level 3. Additionally at Level 4, the '''Freezer''' gains the ability to throw a '''Frost Grenade''', freezing enemies within an explosion radius. The '''Freezer''' does well as an all-rounder support tower. Due to its generally low price and decent DPS, the '''Freezer''' can be a solid choice for early-game defense to mid game with very good cost efficiency. Towards late game, the '''Freezer''' is useful for stalling, defense melting and deal additional DPS through its damage over time, though its DPS is insufficient to deal with late-game waves alone. The '''Freezer''' has [[Lead (Attribute)|lead]] detection from Level 0 and [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] detection from level 2. ==Description==
'''Splash Damage Immunity''' (with its tag referring to it as "''No Explosion''"), also referred to as '''Explosion Immunity''', is an immunity that prevents the enemy from being damaged by most forms of [[Splash Damage]].

==Mechanics==
'''Splash Damage Immunity''' makes enemies immune to [[Splash Damage]]. However, some towers that deal such damage can also deal non-splash damage, which can harm enemies with this immunity as long as they do not have any other attributes that could prevent the tower from doing so. While most forms of [[Splash Damage]] do not deal damage to it, there are some exceptions to this, such as the [[Paintballer]], which is likely due to the game not registering it as dealing explosive damage. If the tower dealing damage has [[Stun Immunity]], explosion damage dealt to the enemy will receive explosion damage from it, but it will be converted to energy. As of currently, this immunity is not used in the game, outside of occasional events which include enemies with this immunity.

Prior to the 24th of December 2019, splash damage did minimal damage to enemies with ''Splash Damage Immunity''. This was because if the enemy was directly targeted by splash damage (called direct damage), they would be damaged. However they would not be damaged if they were not directly targeted, even if they were in the explosion radius. The [[Freezer]] could still deal direct damage until the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], where its [[Splash Damage]] was removed, though it could not freeze the enemies with its projectile.

For towers, it fully or partially prevents them from being stunned and targeted by enemies. ==Mechanics== '''Stun Immunity''' makes it so that any enemy with it cannot be stunned/shocked by towers. They will instead be slowed down by 40% for the stun duration. The '''Stun Immunity''' also grants immunity to being knocked back. The following towers/consumables become unable to apply these effects or have them be weakened to '''Stun Immune''' enemies: *[[Electroshocker]] (Shock) *[[Trapper]] (Stun) *[[Warden]] (Shock) *[[DJ Booth]] (Knockback) *[[Tesla]] (Shock) *[[Mercenary Base]] (Knockback) *[[Brawler]] (Knockback) *[[Commando]] (Stun) *[[Archer]] (Shock) *[[Hallow Punk]] (Knockback) *[[Elementalist]] (Knockback) *[[Warlock]] (Knockback) *[[Flash Bang]] (Stun) *[[Ducky Squad]] ([[Shock Ducky]]) All [[Boss]] enemies have this immunity, as part of being a [[Boss]] enemy. The only difference between the two is that the slowdown effect is weaker on [[Boss]] enemies, as it is 20%. If a [[Boss]] enemy also has the [[Stun Immunity]], it will only be slowed down by 10% instead. ===Towers=== '''Stun Immunity''' makes towers unaffected by stuns from enemies and, in multiple cases, also prevents them from being targeted from such attacks. The immunity to being attacked also applies to some enemy attacks which normally would actually affect them, that being freeze and debuffs. For example, the [[Unstable Ice]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] will not jump at any tower with '''Stun Immunity''' visible in their upgrade menu, even though it can actually freeze them. Similarly, enemies like the [[Clown]] will avoid applying debuffs to towers with '''Stun Immunity''', even if they can be debuffed. Some towers, such as cliff units, also have '''Stun Immunity''', though it is not displayed in their upgrade menu and it is far less effective at preventing them from being targeted by enemy abilities. ==Enemy List== The following enemies have '''Stun Immunity''': {{Scroll|text= *[[Hazmat]] *[[Fallen Hazmat]] *[[Elite Hazmat]] *[[Hazardous]] *[[Fallen]] ([[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] only) *[[Molten Golem]] *[[Giant Boss]] *[[Amalgamation]] ([[Polluted Wasteland II]]) *[[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]] *[[Giant Skeleton]] *[[Cobalt Guard]] *[[Failed Experiment]] *[[Mega Slow]] *[[Fallen Giant]] *[[Fallen Reaper]] *[[Fallen Necromancer]] *[[Fallen Soul (Legacy)|Fallen Soul]] (Legacy version) *[[Glitch]] *[[Fallen Titan]] *[[Fallen Shield]] *[[Fallen Summoner]] ([[Fallen Mode|Fallen]]) *[[Frost Invader]] ([[Frost Mode|Frost]]) *[[Bulwark]] *[[Tanker]] *[[Templar]] (Legacy version) *[[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]] *[[Slow King (Legacy)|Slow King]] (Legacy version) *[[Speedy King (Legacy)|Speedy King]] (Legacy version) *[[Summoner Boss]] *[[Necromancer King]] *[[Conjurer]] *[[Reaper]] *[[Demon]] *[[Error]] *[[Circuit (Hardcore)|Circuit]] ([[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]]) *[[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]] ([[Polluted Wasteland II]]) *[[Molten Titan (Legacy)|Molten Titan]] (Legacy version) *[[Fallen Hero]] *[[Fallen Hero (Legacy)|Fallen Hero]] (Legacy version) *[[Super Toxic]] *[[Mimic Umbra]] *[[Abomination]] *[[Commander (Pizza Party)|Commander]] *[[Fallen Honor Guard]] *[[Packed Ice]] *[[Snow Minion]] *[[Blizzard Wizard]] *[[Frost Hunter]] *[[Frostbane]] *[[Frost Ravager]] *[[Shivergeist]] *[[Frost Hero]] *[[Deep Freeze]] *[[Mega Frost Mystery]] *[[Frost Necromancer]] *[[Frost Champion]] *[[Nuclear Guardia
